Name: RoundedPrices
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: RoundedPrices, command: many)
SELECT id, round(price, 1) AS rounded, roundBankers(price, 1) AS bankers, floor(price) AS floored,
       ceil(price, 1) AS ceiled, trunc(price) AS truncated, round(latency_ms, -1) AS rough_latency,
       round(ratio, 2) AS rough_ratio, round(discount, 1) AS rough_discount
FROM orders;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:round(price, 1)⟩ AS rounded, ⟨c2 aliased:roundBankers(price, 1)⟩ AS bankers, ⟨c3 aliased:floor(price)⟩ AS floored,
       ⟨c4 aliased:ceil(price, 1)⟩ AS ceiled, ⟨c5 aliased:trunc(price)⟩ AS truncated, ⟨c6 aliased:round(latency_ms, -1)⟩ AS rough_latency,
       ⟨c7 aliased:round(ratio, 2)⟩ AS rough_ratio, ⟨c8 aliased:round(discount, 1)⟩ AS rough_discount
FROM orders;

Name: LatencyQuantiles
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: LatencyQuantiles, command: one)
SELECT quantileExact(latency_ms) AS median_latency, quantileExactLow(0.9)(latency_ms) AS low_p90,
       quantileExactHigh(0.9)(price) AS high_p90_price, quantileExactWeighted(latency_ms, id) AS weighted,
       quantileExact(placed_on) AS median_day, quantilesExact(0.5, 0.9)(latency_ms) AS latencies,
       quantile(latency_ms) AS approximate
FROM orders;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:quantileExact(latency_ms)⟩ AS median_latency, ⟨c1 aliased:quantileExactLow(0.9)(latency_ms)⟩ AS low_p90,
       ⟨c2 aliased:quantileExactHigh(0.9)(price)⟩ AS high_p90_price, ⟨c3 aliased:quantileExactWeighted(latency_ms, id)⟩ AS weighted,
       ⟨c4 aliased:quantileExact(placed_on)⟩ AS median_day, ⟨c5 aliased:quantilesExact(0.5, 0.9)(latency_ms)⟩ AS latencies,
       ⟨c6 aliased:quantile(latency_ms)⟩ AS approximate
FROM orders;
